tool_input.description: Verify PII tags on dim_advisor and dim_account
tool_input.sql:
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, TAG_VALUE
FROM TABLE(KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES_ALL_COLUMNS(
  'KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ADVISOR', 'TABLE'
))
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'PII'
UNION ALL
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, TAG_VALUE
FROM TABLE(KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES_ALL_COLUMNS(
  'KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ACCOUNT', 'TABLE'
))
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'PII'
ORDER BY 1, 2
